shared_elements: headdress or head covering rendered as a patterned band above the face
low-relief motifs applied over a body
incised ornament on the torso/upper body
justification: Both depict a human-like figure adorned with a patterned headdress and with relief ornament (including a disc or ring motif) applied over the body, which is a generic anthropomorphic-with-regalia correspondence. Otherwise they differ fundamentally: A is a dense, flat, profile scene of an elaborately costumed figure framed by ordered columns of square sign-blocks, while B is a blocky, frontally massive figure with only sparse, isolated schematic markings and no sign-blocks or narrative scene.
